WITH selected AS ( SELECT source_id FROM ddc_catalog_activation_producer WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND catalog_scope_id=#{catalogScopeId} AND activation_projection_id=#{projectionId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ), selected_messages AS ( SELECT m.page_code, m.message_key, m.default_locale FROM ddc_i18n_source_message m JOIN selected s ON s.source_id=m.source_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.catalog_scope_id=#{catalogScopeId} AND m.deleted_at IS NULL ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM ddc_resource_metadata_projection r JOIN selected s ON s.source_id=r.source_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.catalog_scope_id=#{catalogScopeId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY r.metadata_kind, LOWER(r.definition_key) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM selected_messages GROUP BY LOWER(page_code), LOWER(message_key) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM selected_messages GROUP BY LOWER(page_code) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT page_code) > 1 OR COUNT(DISTINCT default_locale) > 1 ) conflicts
